home.title: Welcome to Labby Driver
home.subtitle: Your trips will appear here once rides go live.

region.outsideBody: We don't operate in this area yet. We're expanding — please check back soon.
region.permissionDeniedBody: We use your location to find your operating region and the right pricing. Allow location access to continue.
region.errorBody: Something went wrong while finding your region. Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartNote: Full right-to-left mirroring is applied after the app restarts.

welcome.title: Drive with Labby
welcome.subtitle: Log in or create an account to start driving.

login.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
login.noAccount: New to Labby? Create an account

register.title: Create account
register.detailsHint: Choose your name and a password of at least 8 characters.
register.termsLabel: I accept the Terms of Service
register.phoneTaken: This phone number is already registered. Log in instead.
register.invalidToken: Your verification expired. Please start over.
register.reactivatedTitle: Welcome back — your account has been reactivated.
register.reactivatedBody: Your rides, wallet, and ratings are all still here. Log in with your old password, or reset it if you forgot it.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.neutralSent: If this number is registered, we sent it a 6-digit code.
reset.doneBody: All other sessions were signed out. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalid: The reset could not be completed. Please start over.

errors.network: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

gate.title: Become a Labby driver
gate.body: Apply in a few short steps. We review every application and keep you updated at each stage.
gate.suspendedBody: Your driver access is currently suspended, so driving functions are unavailable. Contact support for details.
gate.expiredBody: One of your documents has passed its expiry date, so your driver access is suspended. Renew it to get back on the road.
gate.expiredWhatNow: How to get back on the road
gate.expiredSteps: Upload the renewed document with its new number and expiry date. Your access returns as soon as the renewal is approved.
gate.needPersonal: • Your name and a clear profile photo
gate.needDocuments: • Government ID, driver's license, vehicle registration and insurance — each with its number and expiry date
gate.needVehicle: • Your vehicle's details and 1 to 4 photos of it

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.photoOnFile: A profile photo is on file.
profile.photoError: That image cannot be used (unsupported type or size). Try another one.

password.title: Change password
password.codeHint: Changing your password needs a verification code sent to your phone.
password.codeSent: We sent a code to your phone.
password.invalid: Wrong current password or verification code.
password.done: Password changed. All other sessions were signed out.

phone.title: Change phone number
phone.taken: That phone number is already in use.
phone.currentCodeHint: Enter the code we sent to your current phone.
phone.newCodeHint: Enter the code we sent to your new phone.
phone.restart: The code expired or was tried too many times. Start the phone change again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.consequences: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere and ends your access immediately. Your rides, wallet, and ratings are kept, and registering again with the same phone number reactivates your account.
delete.blocked: Your account cannot be deleted right now — finish any active ride and settle your balance first.

documentHints.government_id: Upload your national ID card or passport. Make sure all text is readable.
documentHints.drivers_license: Upload your valid driver's license. Make sure all text is readable.
documentHints.vehicle_registration: Upload the registration document of the vehicle you will drive.
documentHints.insurance: Upload the insurance document covering the vehicle you will drive.

document.fileHint: One file: a photo (JPEG or PNG) or a PDF, up to 10 MB.
document.expiryHint: The document must still be valid after today.

file.rejected: This file couldn't be used. It may be unreadable or of an unsupported type — try another one.
file.tooLarge: This file is too large. The maximum size is 10 MB.
file.wrongTypeDocument: Use a photo (JPEG or PNG) or a PDF file.
file.wrongTypePhoto: Use a JPEG or PNG photo.
file.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Allow it in your phone's settings, or choose a file instead.

personal.hint: Your details as they appear on your account. Riders will see your name and photo.
personal.photoHint: A clear, recent photo of your face — required to apply.
personal.confirm: I've reviewed my name and photo and they are correct

vehicle.hint: Enter the details exactly as they appear on the vehicle registration.
vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.photosHint: Add 1 to {{max}} clear photos of the vehicle (JPEG or PNG). The first photo is the one riders see.

validation.numberTooLong: The document number can be at most 50 characters.
validation.expired: This document has expired or expires today. Use a document that is valid after today.
validation.year: Enter a year from 1980 to next year.
validation.seats: Enter a number of seats from 1 to 8.
validation.photosRequired: Add at least one vehicle photo.
validation.photosTooMany: You can add at most 4 photos.
validation.photoRequired: Add a profile photo to continue.

server.expiresOn: The expiry date was not accepted. It must be after today.

server.file: This file was not accepted. Upload it again.
server.photos: The vehicle photos were not accepted. Add 1 to 4 JPEG or PNG photos again.
server.vehicleField: This value was not accepted. Check it and try again.
server.generic: This item was not accepted. Check it and try again.

errors.network: We couldn't reach Labby. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.serverTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errors.server: Our service had a problem handling this. Please try again in a moment.
errors.invalid: Some details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
errors.fixHighlighted: Some details need fixing — see the highlighted fields.

apply.title: Driver application
apply.conflict: You already have an application in progress or approved.

resubmit.title: Fix flagged items
resubmit.reviewHint: Only these items will be sent back for review.
resubmit.conflict: Your application is no longer waiting for changes. Check its current status.
resubmit.nothing: Your application has nothing waiting to be fixed.

switch.title: Switch vehicle
switch.reviewHint: Your current vehicle stays active until this one is approved.
switch.conflict: You can't submit a vehicle right now — a switch may already be under review.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.body: We received your application. A reviewer will pick it up soon.
submitted.next: Your application is in the queue. You'll be notified when a reviewer starts on it.

under_review.label: Under review
under_review.body: A reviewer is checking your details and documents.
under_review.next: A reviewer is checking your application. You'll be notified of the decision.

needs_changes.label: Needs changes
needs_changes.body: A reviewer asked you to fix a few items before continuing.
needs_changes.next: Fix the flagged items below and resubmit — only those items are needed.

approved.label: Approved
approved.body: Congratulations — you're now a Labby driver.
approved.next: Your driver access is active. Open the driver home to get started.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.body: Your application was not approved this time.
rejected.next: See the reason below. You can apply again with a full new application.

tracker.title: Your driver application
tracker.flaggedHint: The reviewer flagged these items. Everything else is fine as it is.
tracker.reapplyHint: A new application starts from scratch with all details and documents.
tracker.notActiveYet: Your driver access isn't active on your account yet. Try again in a moment.

documents.title: My documents
documents.intro: Keep your documents valid to keep driving. Renew any document before it expires.
documents.renewalPendingHint: Your renewal (valid through {{date}}) is waiting for review.
documents.notApproved: Your documents appear here once you're an approved driver.
documents.expiredBanner: An expired document pauses your driver access until its renewal is approved.

renewal.title: Renew document
renewal.hint: Upload the renewed document with its new number and expiry date. Your current document stays on file until the renewal is approved.
renewal.done: Renewal submitted. We'll let you know once it's reviewed.
renewal.conflict: A renewal of this document is already waiting for review.
renewal.unknownType: This document can't be renewed here.

vehicles.title: My vehicle
vehicles.pendingHint: Your current vehicle stays active until this one is approved.
vehicles.switchBlocked: You can submit another vehicle once the current switch is reviewed.
